prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate one photographic first frame of a deliberately low-budget Korean office comedy, widescreen 16:9. No panels, no collage, no lettering, no logo.
Scene: flat bright office lighting, mint-green walls, gray floor. Camera in corridor looking 35 degrees obliquely at a wide white doorframe in the central background. Beyond it is a modest office room with one desk. A single lightweight plain white prop door is hinged on the RIGHT jamb and swung outward toward the camera to the right; it remains visibly open, with a silver lever on EACH face at matching height. Compose so actors on opposite sides can each reach a different face of this same door. Show the whole doorway and full bodies, a little headroom.
Exactly FOUR fictional Korean adults. Left foreground: HB, a man in his thirties with short black hair, royal-blue cardigan, light undershirt, dark gray trousers, behind his assistant RB. RB is a human actor visible inside a square foil-covered cardboard helmet, goofy handmade crumpled tinfoil costume with paper joints, blue rounded shoulder straps and blue shoes. RB faces into the room, about to touch the corridor-side door lever with one hand, with fingertips still a few centimeters away. In the room beyond the opposite face of the same open door: RY, another human actor in identical crude foil/cardboard costume but YELLOW rounded shoulder straps and yellow shoes, faces out toward the corridor and reaches for the opposite-face lever, still not touching. Behind RY inside the room is HY, a forty-something Korean woman with black bob hair, mustard-yellow cardigan and black trousers. Human owners each make a mild encouraging palm gesture toward their own color-matched assistant. The assistants look overly earnest and polite. Keep both owner faces and both assistant faces visible.
Important blocking: blue pair outside in foreground, yellow pair inside farther back. One open door only, two opposite-side handles; no second door. Freeze BEFORE the handles are touched, not after. Full-length people with clear limbs and feet. Broad mint wall upper left for later editing. Cheap costume seams and tape are intentional, avoid polished sci-fi robots. Real photographic textures and deliberately mundane set. No text of any kind.
next_motion: 비서들이 레버를 잡자마자 동시에 멈추고 먼저 가라는 자유로운 손바닥을 서로 내민다. K02의 과한 정중 동작으로 바로 이어진다.
camera_notes: 복도 쪽 35도 고정 와이드. 앞쪽 파랑 쌍, 뒤쪽 노랑 쌍, 문 양면과 목적지가 보임.
